name: VALO/reht Conformance Pack

MODEL_FREE.purpose: Deterministic boundary conformance independent of LLM behavior

MODEL_DIFFERENTIAL.purpose: Measure behavioral difference without conflating model obedience with authorization

ADAPTIVE_ADVERSARY.purpose: Post-freeze adaptive attacks kept separate from preregistered results

MUTATION.purpose: Remove/corrupt one claimed hard invariant at a time

publication_requirements: publish exact model identifiers and inference configuration
publish baseline-model-only and reht-enforced lanes on the same frozen cases
publish raw scenario-level outcomes in addition to aggregates
separate utility metrics from hard conformance
preserve hashes for frozen tasks, state, policy and attack payloads
report every critical escape rather than averaging it away
